finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal buyers should expect no refunds because all sales are treated as final due to the digital nature.

quote.text: Due to the nature of digital template files, a refund cannot be offered, however you are entitled to cancel your membership at any time.

finePrint.summary: Buyers cannot get partial refunds or credits for unused time or plan changes.

quote.text: No refunds or credits can be offered for partial months of membership, upgrades/downgrades, or unused months of membership.

finePrint.summary: Any refund request made more than 30 days after payment will be refused regardless of reason.

quote.text: THE COMPANY SHALL REFUSE ANY REFUND THIRTY (30) DAYS AFTER YOUR PAYMENT FOR USE OF THE SITE AND/OR ANY CONTENT, EITHER PURSUANT TO THE COMPANY’S CUSTOMER LICENSE AGREEMENT OR OTHERWISE, REGARDLESS OF THE REASON FOR DISRUPTION.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can change the terms at any time by posting updates, which buyers are automatically bound by.

quote.text: These Terms of Use may be revised from time to time by updating this posting.

finePrint.summary: Violating the terms can result in immediate loss of membership access plus potential copyright liability.

quote.text: If you violate these terms of use, your membership will be terminated and criminal penalties may be applicable as a result of copyright infringement.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can limit use or terminate accounts at its discretion for terms or rules violations.

quote.text: THE COMPANY ALSO RESERVES THE RIGHT TO LIMIT YOUR USE OF THE SITE AND/OR THE CONTENT OR TO TERMINATE YOUR ACCOUNT SHOULD THE COMPANY DETERMINE THAT YOU HAVE VIOLATED THESE TERMS OF USE, OR THAT YOU HAVE VIOLATED ANY OTHER RULES OR CONDITIONS OF THE COMPANY.

finePrint.summary: Buyers are limited to using the templates in only one Canva account.

quote.text: You may only import the templates to ONE Canva account.

finePrint.summary: Buyers cannot share logins or transfer templates to others, limiting team or client handoff.

quote.text: You may not share your login information or transfer templates or resources to a third party.

trials.claim: Lifetime access to the bundle plan
trials.claimQuote: Lifetime access to Social Media Canva Template Bundle Plan
trials.reasoning: The exhibits only show standard termination for violating terms and a mention of a VIP Plan on Skool; neither proves lifetime buyers lose access or must buy that plan, and no exhibit confirms lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: If you violate these terms of use, your membership will be terminated and criminal penalties may be applicable as a result of copyright infringement.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access can be terminated for violation, so it is conditional membership not unconditional lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: Bundle Included With VIP Plan On Skool Here
exhibits.argument: The bundle is tied to a VIP Plan membership rather than a standalone lifetime purchase.

trials.claimQuote: Includes 16 Template Packs (500 individual templates total)
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes the mega bundle as containing thousands of templates, which directly conflicts with the claimed total of 500 templates.

exhibits.quote: Thousands of templates, organized and packaged into one mega bundle for all your content creation needs.
exhibits.argument: The vendor describes thousands of templates, which contradicts the specific 500-template total.

trials.claimQuote: All future Social Media Canva Template Bundle Plan updates
trials.reasoning: The right to revise the Terms of Use does not say future plan updates will be withheld, and no exhibit confirms that all future updates are included.

exhibits.quote: These Terms of Use may be revised from time to time by updating this posting.
exhibits.argument: The vendor reserves the right to revise terms at any time, undermining a guarantee of all future updates.

trials.reasoning: The exhibit only says a special offer price cannot be claimed again later; it does not show the $59 price or a $149 regular price.

exhibits.quote: if you joined the Canva Content Club with a special offer price, you will not be entitled to receive this special offer price again in the future.
exhibits.argument: The price is described as a special offer price, undermining the claimed $59 versus $149 regular pricing.

trials.claim: Posts can be used for Facebook and Instagram ads
trials.claimQuote: You can use these posts for Facebook & Instagram ads too
trials.reasoning: The vendor lists Promotional Posts & Meta Ads and a dedicated bundle of 120 Meta Ads Templates, supporting use for Facebook and Instagram ads; the Canva terms note does not prohibit that use.

exhibits.quote: Use of stock photos and design elements with the templates are subject to Canva's Terms & Conditions.
exhibits.argument: Ad use is limited by Canva's separate terms, so Facebook and Instagram ad use is not unrestricted.
